chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr narrated from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Hannat, from al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far عليه السلام say:

No, by Allah, neither al-'Abbas nor 'Ali عليه السلام inherited from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and none inherited from him except Fatimah عليها السلام. And 'Ali عليه السلام only took the weapons and other things because he settled his debt on his behalf.
And blood relatives are nearer to one another in the Book of Allah.

key_terms.أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ: having greater priority over one another
key_terms.أُولُوا الْأَرْحَامِ: blood relatives; those connected by kinship
key_terms.السِّلَاحَ: the weapons taken by Imam 'Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: the Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ عَلَيْهَا السَّلَامُ: Fatimah عليها السلام, identified here as the inheritor
key_terms.قَضَى عَنْهُ دَيْنَهُ: he discharged his debt on his behalf

ai.seo_question: Who inherited from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the inheritance of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم belonged to Sayyidah Fatimah عليها السلام, and that Imam 'Ali عليه السلام did not take the Prophet’s belongings as an heir, but in connection with settling his debts. The cited Qur'anic phrase supports the principle that blood relatives have prior claim over inheritance according to Allah’s decree.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5606 - Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr narrated from Al-Hasan bin Musa Al-Hannat, from Al-Fudhayl bin Yasar, who said:
I heard Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) say:

"By Allah (swt), neither Al-Abbas nor Ali (as) inherited from the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family). None inherited from him except Sayyida Fatimah {s.a} (peace be upon her).
And Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) only took the weapons and other items because He (as) had settled his (the Prophet's (sw)) debts."
Then Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) recited the verse of Allah (swt);

"And the blood relatives are nearer to each other in the Book of Allah (swt)."
(Surah Al-Ahzab 33:6)
